sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: [2608.30114] Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese ...
sources.snippet: We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics.

sources.title: liodon-ai/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-ONNX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ONNX export of unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, published by Liodon AI. Exported with optimum (optimum.exporters.onnx.main_export, task text-generation-with-past, so the graph exposes past-key-value inputs/outputs for KV-cached autoregressive decoding).
